en: Whew, that was close!{PAGE}Thanks for coming, guys! You really{SAUT}saved our asses.
Yosukeeeee! You're human after aaaall!
Huh? What are you crying about?{PAGE}You don't even know what I've been{SAUT}through!{PAGE}Waking up in some jungle―full of{SAUT}talking dinosaurs!? This makes no{SAUT}sense...
I'm glad you were safe.{OPTION}Are you hurt?
Uh, yeah, but it's no big―{PAGE}W-Wait! Who are you!?
These are our companions that we met{SAUT}here. They're Persona-users, just like us.
We got sucked into this world just{SAUT}like you did.{PAGE}Now we've teamed up to find a way{SAUT}back to our own worlds. Pleased to{SAUT}meet you!
Same here... So, uh, are you a cat in{SAUT}a costume, or a person in a cat costume,{SAUT}like with Teddie, or...?
Listen to me. I am NOT in a costume,{SAUT}and I am NOT a cat!
...Anyway, I'm glad you're safe, Yosuke.{SAUT}We were all really worried about you.
Aw, thanks, guys. Sorry for worrying{SAUT}you...{PAGE}I would've managed better if I were{SAUT}alone, but I've been trying to protect{SAUT}this talking dinosaur I met here...
You fought your way here... all by{SAUT}yourself? That's badass, Yosuke-senpai!
Haha, I'm all beat up though... I guess{SAUT}that makes these wounds my medals{SAUT}of honor?
Um... Thank you...
Aw, don't worry about it! We gotta help{SAUT}each other out when we're in trouble,{SAUT}y'know.{PAGE}...Hey, look who's back. I guess they{SAUT}were worried about you too.
See? We saved her! Aren't you glad?
Oh yeah! As good an ending as we{SAUT}could ask for!
Don't they seem to be reacting kinda...{SAUT}strangely?
So... Should we do the thing?
...Y-Yeah, I guess so.
Time to put it to a vote.
Wait―what!?
All those who think we should allow{SAUT}the humans to remain in our herd,{SAUT}raise your hand!
Hey! What the hell!?
Now, all those who think we should kick{SAUT}them out, raise your hand!
Based on a unanimous vote, the humans{SAUT}are hereby kicked out. Leave them here.
But, why?
......{PAGE}*sigh* It's all your fault...
Holy―He has my head!!! What the hell{SAUT}is happening here!?
You guys ignored the majority rule!
Wha... What are you even talking about?
We're done with you guys. Just...{SAUT}go and do whatever you want, but{SAUT}leave us alone!
And there they go...
Dude... What was all that about?{PAGE}And WHY did he have MY HEAD!?{SAUT}I have no idea what's happening,{SAUT}and I'm getting really freaked out!
It's a long story.{OPTION}If you calm down, I'll tell you.
Yeah―Yosuke-kun seems exhausted,{SAUT}too. It might be better if we talked{SAUT}about it in a safer place.
Yeah... You're right. Go ahead and{SAUT}lay it on me―I'm listening.
Well, it's a long story... it might be better{SAUT}if we talked about it in a safer place.{PAGE}Yosuke-kun seems exhausted, too...
Well then, let's return to the movie{SAUT}theater.
Wait―did you say a movie theater?{SAUT}Your base isn't some cave or tent!?
Okay, I guess we should explain SOME{SAUT}things along the way. C'mon, follow us.
